|is_drop_restricted = true |is_corrupted = True |release_version = 3.3.0 }} '''Vaal Earthquake''' is a [[Vaal skill gem]]. The [[character]] strikes the ground, creating a crack that erupts in an aftershock after a short [[duration]]. Moving will create a new crack as soon as the previous crack has erupted, until a total of 9 cracks have been created, or the secondary duration expires. While this skill is active, the user will also create smaller shockwaves around them with each step they take. ==Skill functions and interactions== * Weapon swapping does not end the secondary duration as long as the item that Vaal Earthquake is socketed in is still active (i.e. not in the inactive weapon swap, or an item with unmet requirements).https://youtu.be/mB1Ah_wZzKY ** This can be used with legacy {{il|Yaomac's Accord}} to lessen the soul cost. Vaal Earthquake does not [[snapshot]] the weapon's stats, so after using the skill with Yaomac's Accord, you can swap to a high damage weapon. ** Current {{il|Yaomac's Accord}}s that increase level of Vaal skill gems do not work. ** To make the activation faster, a {{il|Brightbeak}} can be equipped in the main hand. * The skill's aftershock proc rate does not scale with attack speed; instead, the rate is based on the character's running animation. ** This means that the skill's hit rate benefits from higher movement speed up to a certain cap. ** Note that like {{sl|Abberath's Fury}} the aftershocks have an internal cooldown and exceeding the proc rate by moving too fast will cause Vaal EQ to not proc on each step. ** [[Character size]] modifiers also affects how often the character takes a step. This means that [[Massive Shrine|Massive Shrines]] can cause a DPS loss. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = More
